（၁） အသံမြည်စေသော၊ မှုတ်သော၊ သူ။ （၂） ပျက်စီးစေသော၊ မှုတ်-ထုတ်-ဖျက်ဆီး-သော၊ သူ။ （၃） မီးမှုတ်သော၊ သူ။

D: Dhameti，（dham + e），吹，使发声。 【过】 ~esi。 【过分】 dhamita。 【现分】dhamenta。 【使】 dhamāpeti。（p163）

R:
dhameti：ဓမေတိ （ကာ） （√ဓမ်+ဏေ）
မှုတ်၏။
အန္ဓံ ဓမေတွာန၊ အမိုက်မှောင်ကို ဖျက်ဆီး၍။
DOP: dhamati ~eti, ~ayati, pr. 3 sg. [ S. dhamati], Dhātup 227 (dhama sadde); Dhātum 325 (dhamo pumo ca dhamane); Sadd 412, 21 foll. (dhama saddaggisaṃyogesu); 1. blows; makes sound (esp. a conch or other wind instrument by blowing) ; Ja I 284, 1´ (~eyya); 284, 22* (~e ~e nātidhame); 364, 22 (tvaṃ saṅkhaṃ ~a); VI 580, 28* (kharamukhāni ~antu, Ee, Se so; Ce dhammantu; Be ~entu); Mil 31, 1 (ye pan’ ime saṅkhadhamakā saṅkhaṃ ~enti tesaṃ vāto puna pavisatī ti); 262, 3 (mahatimahantā pi macchā … ācamanti ~anti ca); Ap-a 411, 26 (saṅkhaṃ ~ati ghosaṃ karotī ti saṅkhadhamako, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~ayati); Sadd 412, 23 (saṅkhaṃ ~ati saṅkhadhamako bheriṃ ~ati bheridhamako); — 2. stirs up (fire) by blowing ; Ja VI 372, 4 (na … aggimhi vijjamāne yeva khajjopanakaṃ ~anti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~enti); 441, 28 (aggimhi sante khajjopanakaṃ ~ati); Sadd 412, 24 (aggiṃ ~ati); — 3. melts or manufactures by blowing, smelts; blows away ; A I 253, 32 (suvaṇṇakāro … taṃ jātarūpaṃ mūsāyaṃ pakkhipitvā ~ati sandhamati niddhamati); IV 169, 1 (~ath’ etaṃ bhikkhave puggalaṃ niddhamath’ etaṃ bhikkhave puggalaṃ, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se niddhamath’ etaṃ … niddhamath’ etaṃ …); Nidd I 478, 25 (suvaṇṇakāro jātarūpassa oḷārikaṃ pi malaṃ ~ati sandhamati niddhamati; Nidd-a I 453, 30 : thūlaṃ malaṃ aggisaṃyogena nīharati); — part.pr. ( a ) dhama(t), mfn. , Ja I 284, 23* (te tāto vidhamī ~aṃ; 284, 25´ : mama pitā punappuna ~anto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~ento); ( b ) dhamanta, dhamenta, mfn. , Ja I 122, 28´ (paṇḍito puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ … mukhavātena ~anto samuṭṭhāpeti vaḍḍheti); II 110, 7 (saṅkhe ~entā bheriyo vādentā); Ap 391, 12 (saṅkhaṃ … ~anto sabbadivasaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~ento); Sp 621, 13 (paṇṇanāḷikā, taṃ ~antā kīḷanti); Sv 391, 28 (aggiṃ pahāya khajjopanakaṃ ~ento viya); 602, 22 (bhastāhi ~antā); Ps V 54, 12 (aṅgāre pakkhipitvā aggiṃ datvā nāḷikāya ~ento aggiṃ jāleyya); Spk III 107, 8 (vidhamatī ti ~anto viya nāseti, Ce so; Be Ee, Se ~ento); ( c ) dhamamāna 1 , mfn. , M I 243, 9 (kammāragaggariyā ~amānāya adhimatto saddo hoti) = S I 106, 23 ( or pass. , cf Spk I 173, 14 : tassa vātena pūriyamānāya); Ja I 72, 8 (Sakko devarājā vijayuttarasaṅkhaṃ ~amāno aṭṭhāsi); VI 165, 27´ (kammāragaggarī viya ~amānā susū ti saddaṃ karontā; or pass. ); Spk I 206, 24 (aggiṃ pahāya khajjopanakaṃ ~amānā viya, Be, Se so; Ce dhamamanā; Ee dhamānā); — aor. 3 sg dhami, Ja I 171, 28 (ekaṃ naḷadaṇḍakaṃ … mukhena ~i, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pumi); 284, 19 ; Mhv 25:65 (saṅkhaṃ ~i Phussadevo); — inf. dhamituṃ, Ja VI 371, 8 (agginā atthe sati khajjopanakaṃ ~ituṃ … na vaṭṭatī ti); — absol. dhamitvā, dhametvā, Ja I 172, 2 (~itvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pumitvā); 284, 24´ (saṅkhaṃ ~itvā); Vism 144, 23 (sakalasarīraṃ ~itvā pūritavatthi viya … anuparipphuṭaṃ hoti) = As 117, 1 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pharitvā) ≠ Paṭis-a 182, 34 ; Sv 811, 22 (~itvā); Ap-a 411, 16 (saṅkhaṃ ~etvā, Be, Se so; Ce ~ayati; Ee omits ); — pass. part.pr. ( a ) dhamayanta, mfn. , (?) Ap 360, 8 (vajjamānāsu bherisu saṅkhesu ~ayantesu, eds so ); ( b ) dhamamāna 2 , mfn. [ cf S. dhamyamāna, dhmāyamāna], being blown; being smelted ; Mil 67, 6 (khuddako pi pāsāṇo pākatike aggimhi pakkhitto divasaṃ pi ~amāno na vilayaṃ gacchati, Ee so; Ce ḍayhamāno; Be, Se paccamāno); Sv 706, 3 (kaṇṇamūle ~amānassa saṅkhayugalassā pi); 879, 13 (~amānaṃ niddosajātarūpaṃ viya adhikataraṃ sobhati) = Spk III 209, 7 ( Be, Ee, Se so; Ce dhammamānaṃ); Ap-a 77, 10 (so kira saṅkho … sakiṃ vātaṃ gāhāpetvā ~amāno cattāro māse saddaṃ karitvā nissaddo hoti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se dhamiyamāno); — pp dhanta , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) smelted ; A I 253, 33 (taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ ~aṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee … aniddhantaṃ; Se adhantaṃ asandhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ); — 2. ( n. ) blowing ; Ja I 284, 23* (~enādhigatā bhogā); — sudhanta, mfn. , well-smelted ; M III 243, 18 (jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sudhantaṃ niddhantaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee suddhantaṃ; Se omits ); Vism 377, 7 (mudu hi cittaṃ kammanīyaṃ hoti sudhantam iva suvaṇṇaṃ) = Sp 157, 21 ( Be, Ce so; Ee suddhantam; Se sunidhantam); — caus. pr. 3 sg. dhamāpeti , Ja VI 7, 19 (saṅkhadhamake … saṅkhe ~āpenti); — absol. dhamāpetvā, Dhp-a I 442, 7 (aggiṃ katvā bhastā yojāpetvā sabbarattiṃ ~etvā); — see also atidhamati.
